title: Belief in the Last Day
intro: The fifth pillar of iman: this world will end, and every person will meet Allah.

learn.html: Wal-yawmil-aakhir – belief in the Last Day – is the fifth pillar of iman. A Muslim believes that this world will one day end, and that after it comes the Akhirah, the next life, which never ends.

learn.title: When is the Last Day?
learn.html: Only Allah knows when the Last Day (Qiyamah) will come. Not even the angels or the prophets know. The Prophet (SAW) told us about some signs before it, so that people would remember it and prepare.

items: By Allah’s command the angel Israfil will blow the Sur (the trumpet)
The world as we know it will end – mountains, seas and sky will change
Then the Sur is blown again and all people are brought back to life (next lesson)
Every person will see their deeds, even the smallest good or evil deed <small>(Qur’an, Az-Zalzalah 99:7–8)</small>

learn.text: The barzakh – the life of the grave

learn.html: Between death and the Last Day is the barzakh. In the grave every person is asked: Who is your Lord? What is your religion? Who is your Prophet? A believer answers: Allah is my Lord, Islam is my religion, Muhammad (SAW) is my Prophet.

learn.title: Why does it matter?
learn.html: Belief in the Last Day makes us responsible: we know every deed counts. It gives us hope – no good deed is lost – and keeps us away from wrong, even when no one is watching.

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: This world is a field where we plant deeds; in the Akhirah we harvest them.

practice.title: In order
practice.prompt: Put these in order, from first to last.
items: Barzakh – the life of the grave
The Sur is blown and the world ends
Everyone is brought back to life

questions.q: Which pillar of iman is belief in the Last Day?
Who knows when the Last Day will come?
Which angel will blow the Sur?

options: The life between death and the Last Day

questions.q: Which three questions are asked in the grave?
options: Who is your Lord, what is your religion, who is your Prophet
How old are you, where do you live, what is your name
What did you eat, where did you go, who are your friends

questions.q: How does belief in the Last Day help us?
options: It makes us responsible for our deeds
It makes us afraid of everything
